scope: Independent internal semantic and exact-file review of the original deterministic synthetic bounded expected-endpoint curvature candidate. This is not external qualified scientific peer review, empirical authentication or statistical validation.

semantic_findings.claims_and_admission: ACCEPT: flags are declarations, not authenticated controls. No empirical data, CI, P value, power, cancer efficacy, causal confirmation or mathematical novelty is claimed; no literature novelty search is implied.
semantic_findings.conventional_full_proportionality: ACCEPT: routewise m/(qgr) scale intervals have a common context scale exactly when the full theta=eta=0 model is feasible under the box. Necessary K=1 alone allows nonzero eta and is not labeled a full conventional fit.
semantic_findings.corner_sharpness: ACCEPT: signs of the monomial exponents fix coordinate monotonicity on each admitted positive real Cartesian box; the minimum and maximum corners attain the reported rational extrema.
semantic_findings.cross_context_feasibility: ACCEPT: the context domains are Cartesian apart from the tested shared curvature, so nonempty closed interval intersection is necessary and sufficient for some common K. Contact is feasible; shared dependence would invalidate this sufficiency and is explicitly excluded.
semantic_findings.fixed_vs_free_forecast: ACCEPT: existence of an arbitrary common K differs from compatibility of a locked rational K0; even a fixed-curvature gate still refits eta and is not a complete held-out probability forecast.
semantic_findings.full_interval_image: ACCEPT: compactness, connectedness and continuity make the positive real image the full closed interval, including irrational interior witnesses; rational endpoints do not promise rational interior reconstruction.
semantic_findings.non_cartesian_scope: ACCEPT: boxes may remain outer enclosures under an independently justified containment assumption, but overlap would not prove feasibility in a smaller dependent joint set; engine refuses declared non-Cartesian inputs.
semantic_findings.observation_scope: ACCEPT: m denotes population expected recovered endpoint mass; normalized expected masses are not asserted to equal expected realized fractions, founder/culture/lineage count laws, categorical outcomes or first-arrival probabilities.
semantic_findings.residual_reconstruction: ACCEPT: z=m/(qgr), kappa=sqrt(z1*z3), exp(eta)=sqrt(z1/z3), exp(theta)=z2/sqrt(z1*z3) establish completeness of K=exp(2theta) for free positive context scale and eta, over real parameters.
semantic_findings.simplex_scope: ACCEPT: normalization of unnormalized masses and relative supply weights preserves curvature; it does not admit independent normalized-share intervals without their sum constraint. That representation is explicitly refused.
